WITH driver_qualifying_counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_records
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY driverId
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS avg_records
  FROM driver_qualifying_counts
)
SELECT dqc.driverId,
       dqc.qualifying_records,
       1.0 * dqc.qualifying_records / ac.avg_records AS ratio_to_average
FROM driver_qualifying_counts AS dqc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
